duelInfo.title: How Duels Work
duelInfo.whatAreDuelsDesc: Duels are ranked one-vs-one challenges between players. They award ELO points and affect your global ranking. A duel is recorded as a ranked match and uses the standard ELO formula.
duelInfo.weeklyLimitDesc: Each player can issue up to {{max}} challenges per week. The weekly counter resets every {{day}} at {{time}}.
duelInfo.eloRestrictionDesc: You cannot challenge a player who is more than {{restriction}} ELO points below you. This prevents high-ranked players from farming lower-ranked opponents.
duelInfo.eloRestrictionExample: Example: if you have 1700 ELO, you can challenge players down to {{min}} ELO.
duelInfo.expirationDesc: A pending challenge expires after {{days}} days if not accepted or recorded. Once expired, the challenge is no longer active and does not count against weekly limits.
duelInfo.noRepeatDesc: You can only challenge the same opponent once per week. Wait until the next weekly reset to challenge them again.
duelInfo.eloPointsDesc: Winning a duel increases your ELO; losing decreases it. The amount depends on both players' current ELO and the winner's K-factor. Unranked players (with no points yet) start from 1500 for their first duel.
duelInfo.maxChallengesPerWeekHelp: Maximum number of duel challenges a player can create per week
duelInfo.eloRestrictionHelp: Players cannot challenge opponents this many ELO points below them. Prevents high-ranked players from farming low-ranked players.
duelInfo.challengeExpirationHelp: Number of days before an unaccepted challenge expires
duelInfo.allowMandatoryDuelsHelp: If disabled, players cannot create mandatory challenges.
duelInfo.mandatoryPerWeekHelp: Number of mandatory duels a player can create per week. Set to 0 to allow unlimited (not recommended).

rankingInfo.title: How ELO & Ranks Work
rankingInfo.startingSuffix: {{rank}} rank. After each ranked match the winner gains points and the loser loses the exact same amount. There are no draws — every match has a winner.
rankingInfo.kFactorTextPrefix: The K-Factor decides how many points move after a match. It is based on the
rankingInfo.kFactorTextSuffix: , not a fixed league-wide number. Lower-rated players have a higher K, so upsets reward more points and top-tier wins move very little.
rankingInfo.legendTextPrefix: The top 5 players on the leaderboard receive the
rankingInfo.legendTextSuffix: , no matter how many points they have. Once a player drops out of the top 5 they return to their point-based rank.
rankingInfo.examplesSubtitle: These examples show the same ELO engine used by “Record Match” and league matches.

howItWorks.weeklyAssignment: Weekly assignment: every Monday (or period start) the Schedule tab updates with your new opponents for the week.
howItWorks.playMatch: Play your match: contact your opponent and play the match during the week.
howItWorks.reportResult: Report the result: any of the two players can open the match and report the score, winner and optional photo. The match is not final yet.
howItWorks.confirm: Other player confirms: the opponent opens the same match and reports the same result. When both match, the result is finalized and ELO is updated.
howItWorks.differ: If results differ: the match goes to Pending Review. An admin will check the evidence and decide the final result.
howItWorks.grace: Grace period: if you cannot play in the exact week, you have
howItWorks.graceSuffix: {{days}} extra days to finish and report the match.
howItWorks.noShows: No-shows: if a player does not show up, the present player wins. If a player reaches
howItWorks.noShowsSuffix: {{count}} no-shows, an admin can kick them from the league.
howItWorks.standings: Standings: wins and losses update the ELO ranking. Playoffs are available for the Top 8 if enabled.

important.sameScore: Both players must report the same score/winner for the match to count automatically.
important.screenshot: Always attach a screenshot if the opponent might disagree.
important.expired: After {{days}} days the match can be marked as expired and reviewed by an admin.
important.adminConflict: If you are not an admin, you cannot resolve conflicts.
